name: MPM Memory
description: Memory slot backed by MPM (Memory Persistence Module). Routes memory_search/memory_get through `mpm call query_long_term_memory`. FTS5-only recall (no semantic vector). Replaces the default memory-core. Requires MPM installed on PATH and the agent configured with `plugins.slots.memory = "openclaw-mpm-memory"` to clear the `core/doctor/memory-search` 'No active memory plugin' warning.

mpmBin.description: Path to the mpm binary. Default 'mpm' (PATH-resolved).

scope.description: MPM query scope. Default 'all' (federated local + shared MPM DBs).

limitDefault.description: Default memory_search limit when maxResults is omitted. Default 6.
